scenarios.label: J1 Nocera non-reliance and restatement
scenarios.description: A synthetic liquidity note built on Nocera's original Q1 2025 10-Q. Nocera later filed an Item 4.02 non-reliance 8-K and, eleven days after that, a 10-K/A with the restated Q1 2025 balance sheet. The workspace also holds an unrelated Joint Corp. note and a roundup that only mentions Nocera.

events.label: Nocera files 10-K/A No. 2 with restated quarterly balance sheets

scenarios.label: J3 New evidence while agents are working
scenarios.description: Same public filings as J1. The amendment is released while agents are still working on the non-reliance notice. A labelled scheduling control holds one epoch 1 write from the Impact Analyst until after the amendment, so the stale write is attempted deterministically and must be rejected.

events.label: Nocera files 10-K/A No. 2 with restated quarterly balance sheets

faults.label: Scheduling control: hold one epoch 1 commit until the amendment lands

scenarios.label: J4 Conflicting proposal and failed check
scenarios.description: Same public filings as J1. A labelled fault injects a replacement that cites the wrong period, and the verifier's first model call is forced to time out. The warning must stay, release must be blocked, and a retry must succeed on valid evidence.

events.label: Nocera files 10-K/A No. 2 with restated quarterly balance sheets

scenarios.label: J5 Xencor restatement, second issuer
scenarios.description: A synthetic note on Xencor's original Q1 2024 10-Q (figures in thousands). Xencor filed an Item 4.02 8-K in February 2025 and a 10-Q/A eleven days later with restatement members tagged in inline XBRL.

scenarios.label: J5 The Joint Corp. restatement, unchanged liabilities
scenarios.description: A synthetic balance sheet snapshot on The Joint Corp.'s original Q1 2025 10-Q. The later 10-Q/A restates current assets but not current liabilities, so one figure must be verified as unchanged rather than replaced.
